limitations: No opening hours were proposed because the official locator does not publish hours.
No generic brand homepage/menu URLs proposed because prior workbook may contain other exact branch-specific sources; this batch focuses on branch-specific contacts.
Locator entries without phone or with ambiguous unit/site were not proposed.

method: Verified TLS HTTP 200 fetch of Subway Singapore official locator; parsed 154 published location entries; matched only blank contact cells using exact postal code and street identity with uniqueness; added brand-level official website/menu URLs only to blank exact-brand rows. No hours are published in the locator. Workbook not edited.
